يستكتبا (form X)
# يَسْتَكْتِبَا (yastaktibā) /jas.tak.ti.baː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْتَبَ (istaktaba)
# يُسْتَكْتَبَا (yustaktabā) /jus.tak.ta.baː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْتَبَ (istaktaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
